summary: Four gimmes (Hong Kong, New York, Dubai, Shanghai), Shenzhen, Kuala Lumpur and Bangkok with thought, Mumbai and Wuhan as the surprises. Famous skylines outside the top 10 (Tokyo by one tower, Chicago, Singapore, London) eat lives fast, so it plays a little hard.
reasons: Casual found 6 (New York, Dubai, Hong Kong, Shanghai, Kuala Lumpur, Shenzhen) and lost all 5 lives on Tokyo #11 (200), Chicago #14, Singapore #13, London #44 and Beijing #29, each with its count: learnable misses, but many of them. Fan found 9, missing only Mumbai.
Matching is clean: nyc, hk, kl, bombay, canton, shenzen, kuala lampur and bankok all score; towers, countries and "skyscraper" are free; Manila (split into its cities by the source) is free.

The page mixes sources: Mumbai's 247 includes topped-out towers and Bangkok's and Tokyo's counts come from Wikipedia lists, not the Skyscraper Center, so the #10/#11 cut is one building across two sources. The prompt states the measure and players won't see the seam.
fixes: Taipei (a likely guess, for Taipei 101), Tel Aviv, Jersey City, Sharjah, Taguig, Burnaby, Yokohama and Kawasaki cost a life with no figure, but the page's metro-area table lists each one's city count in its "Cities included" column (Taipei 16, Tel Aviv 24, Jersey City 22, Sharjah 26). Show those. Not 39 for Taipei: that figure adds New Taipei City.
Singapore shows 140 (#13) from the main table, but the page's metro-area and height tables both give 100 (about #21). Check which is current; it is one of the most common misses.
